page: Microsoft Azure EC16as_v6 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ECasv6 family. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached storage, though the instance is designated as Premium Storage capable. There are no onboard GPUs, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads. Additionally, the instance does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the EC16as_v6 offers high memory density relative to its compute allocation. This resource profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-intensive workloads that do not require local disk space or GPU acceleration. It is suited for relational databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise applications, and memory-heavy data processing tasks.
